sn36.16:1.1: kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Ānandam Bhagavā etad avoca || || Katamā nu kho vedanā || katamo vedanānirodho || katamā vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā || ko vedanāya assādo || ko ādinavo || kim nissaraṇan ti || Bhagavaṃmūlakā no bhante dhammā Bhagavannettikā Bhagavaṃpaṭisaraṇā || sādhu bhante Bhagavantaññeva paṭibhātu etassa bhāsitassa attho || Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti || || Tena hi Ānanda suṇohi sādhukam manasi karohi bhāsissāmīti || || Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā Ānando paccassosi || || Bhagavā etad avoca || || Tisso imā Ānanda vedanā || sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā || imā vuccanti Ānanda vedanā || la || phassasamudayo || la || khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno rāgo paṭippassaddho hoti || doso paṭippassaddho hoti || moho paṭippassaddho hotīti || || Atha
